scenarios.title: Water finds its level
scenarios.description: A full basin with a gap in its front wall. Water runs out through the gap and spreads across the floor, thinning as it goes. Widen the gap to let more out.

scenarios.title: Loose blocks fall
scenarios.description: A column hung in the air drops and piles on the floor. Sand and gravel fall; the stone beside them stays where it is.

scenarios.title: Walls to get over
scenarios.description: Walls one, two and three blocks tall, thin and thick. Run at the one-block walls and press Space to vault. Jump at the taller ones and press Space again in the air to mantle or hang; then A and D shimmy, Space pulls up, Ctrl lets go.
